description: Save or change the signed-in person's own signature on Signatoro: name, title, phone, email, website, LinkedIn, extra link, photo, review badge, booking button, layout, color and font. With nothing saved yet, this creates the signature. Give only the fields to change; the rest keep their saved values, and "" clears a field. Company brand items (logo, company colors, the company review badge or booking button) are set by the company owner on signatoro.com: fields the company controls are left unchanged and listed in ignored, with who changes them; tell the person. A connected mailbox (Zoho Mail) gets the new signature. Returns the updated signature as HTML and text with sender, the details as fields, and counts as one signature request like get_signature; with the month used up, the change is saved and the signature held back. When nothing changed, nothing is written or counted.

bookingProvider.description: Booking button provider: calendly, cal, other, or "" to remove the button.

bookingUrl.description: Booking page URL. The button needs it.

color.description: Accent color as a 6-digit hex, e.g. "#6a040f".

extraLinkLabel.description: Text of one extra link, e.g. "Book a demo".

extraLinkUrl.description: URL of the extra link. Shown only with extraLinkLabel.

layout.description: One of line, mark, portrait, stack, compact. Call list_templates to choose.

logoUrl.description: Only a logo uploaded on signatoro.com is accepted; "" removes the logo.

phone.description: Phone number as it should read.

photoUrl.description: Only a photo uploaded on signatoro.com is accepted; "" removes the photo.

reviewPlatform.description: Review badge platform: trustpilot, google, g2, or "" to remove the badge.

reviewRating.description: Score, e.g. "4.8". Needed for google and g2.

reviewUrl.description: Link to the reviews page. The badge needs it.

name: update_my_signature
title: Save or update my signature
